checks.detail: Launch a minimal native Godot prototype with a simple bounded placeholder room, a player camera and ordinary keyboard/mouse input. This is an intentionally rough first increment: do not import the authored FPS map, real weapon or hand assets, HUD package, minimap package, enemy package or decorative asset collection. Verify the game starts without a black screen, missing-resource error or direct dependency on final content.

Use ordinary input to look and move the placeholder player inside the bounded prototype. Require stable camera framing, a visible floor, predictable input capture/release and a deterministic restart state. Placeholder geometry is permitted and expected; production scale, authored landmarks, weapons, HUD and map quality are explicitly out of scope.

Issue one narrow bootstrap verdict for the launchable placeholder loop. Accept only a real runnable shell and basic camera/input evidence; do not expand this first phase into map import, weapon implementation, HUD, minimap, enemy AI or final presentation.

Replace the accepted placeholder blockout with exactly one complete authored FPS environment from the asset pool. Launch through ordinary input and traverse its spawn-to-Alpha route. Require the PRD's 30-45 second effective spawn-to-A route budget with meaningful native cover and route decisions; reject moving Alpha close to spawn, shortening the route to make collision validation pass, or reporting a below-target route as acceptable. Require human-scale collision-backed ground, a fixed safe spawn, readable cover and landmarks, neutral daylight exposure, and no roof spawn, void, fall-through, decorative barriers, loose model placement or modular kit scatter. The authored map is first allowed in this phase; do not add real weapon/hand components, HUD, minimap or enemy AI yet.

Inspect the imported environment's complete native hierarchy, bounds, materials, collision and route datum. Require one intact instance supplying the dominant visible world, with product-owned outer support only. Reject extracted child meshes, broad proxy floors, cloned facades, missing textures, floating anchors, disconnected streets, raw-AABB minimap assumptions and source mutation.

Issue one map-integration verdict for the playable authored spawn-to-Alpha environment. The complete map, ground contact, collision, scale and route must be coherent in one ordinary-input run, and the route must preserve the PRD's 30-45 second effective travel budget rather than relocating Alpha to a trivial near-spawn endpoint. Do not require later weapon, HUD, minimap, enemy AI or cinematic behavior in this phase.

Play fresh uninterrupted encounters against the required 3 Alpha, 5 Bravo and 10 Charlie enemies. Verify multiple spatial clusters, autonomous locomotion, navigation separation, perception, search, flank, cover reservation, aim telegraph, fire, reload, hit reaction and death. Reject static or duplicated enemies, first-frame fire, wall tracking, teleporting, sliding poses, overlapping capsules, doorway deadlocks, frozen groups or damage without a real enemy shot event.

Inspect continuous motion for player weapons/hands and all visible enemy states. Require stable roots and sockets, weapon-hand contact, locomotion without foot sliding, readable aim/fire/hurt/death transitions, no T-pose or transform-only substitute, and third-person victory dance framing that faces the user after combat freezes.

Fail. The ledger-bound 70/80 ms mouse/gamepad reproduction consumed three rounds for two presses. Fresh enemy-hit evidence aligned enemy:rift_a_02 shot IDs, ammo 12→11→10, health 100→97→94, directional damage state and camera response, but the hit frame and adjacent burst did not show a readable muzzle, tracer or impact result. A line-of-fire-blocked state preserved health and ammo without fabricating a damage event.

Fail. Extended ordinary movement, jump, combat and route probes never reached Alpha: overlap remained false, capture progress remained zero and no key or terminal event was committed. Repeated mouse-look and right-stick probes left yaw at 12.6 degrees, preventing normal navigation around the spawn-route obstruction. TerminalPresentation consequently remained inactive with completion_count=0, so neither required terminal path is executable from ordinary gameplay.

Fail. Title and loadout retain coherent licensed typography and focus treatment, but Escape remains bound to pause and menu_back, saved ui_scale=2 is not applied to the shell/HUD, reduced-motion settings are not bound to presentation owners, and the briefing is a static prose page instead of the required cinematic flow.

Fail. Daylight material detail and mesh integrity remain acceptable. However, two synchronized enemy damage events reached health and camera feedback without a readable muzzle/tracer/impact result in the captured frames. The ordinary progression defect also prevents the objective and bomb event layers from being reached as part of a complete mission.

Fail. A 97-frame profiler run measured average frame time 145.03 ms, p95 158.31 ms and approximately 7 FPS under Mesa llvmpipe; this software-renderer measurement cannot isolate candidate GPU performance. More importantly, three consecutive F6 restores advanced restore_epoch to 4 and restored health, ammo and all 18 enemies, but stale damage_commit_count=13, last_damage_event and last_input_receipt remained in the reset player/weapon state. The ordinary progression defect prevented explosion timing from being reached.

Issue one integrated verdict for the complete Fusepoint vertical slice across world, movement, both weapons, 18 enemies, A/B capture, C defusal, HUD/minimap, story, audio/VFX, ordinary death, success, detonation failure, menus, accessibility and restart stability. Require continuous current-candidate evidence and name the highest-impact blocker; source inspection, labels, beauty frames or self-reported completion are insufficient.

required_criteria.requirement: Bind state logs, continuous frames and audio for player/enemy fire, near miss, material impact, player damage, enemy hit, kill and death. Require synchronized muzzle flash, animation, recoil, projectile/tracer or pellet result, occlusion, impact VFX/audio, red edge damage mask, camera response and a restrained right-side yellow kill notification such as 'YOU KILLED' without opaque cards or debug labels. Enemy death must have clear animation and sound feedback.

Execute both terminal paths from ordinary gameplay. Success must atomically defuse before zero, freeze combat, move to a safe third-person camera, play the character victory dance, show score/time/rank and offer replay/home. Failure must atomically detonate at zero, set health to zero once, disable combat, layer flash/fire/sparks/debris/shockwave/dust/light/audio, shake then lower the camera, expand and decay the red damage mask, play the failure video or still fallback, and offer retry/home without a generic Game Over label.

Navigate title, briefing/loading, loadout, gameplay, pause, settings, ordinary death recovery, success result, failure result and replay using keyboard/mouse and gamepad. Require coherent grounded typography and transparent AAA-style information hierarchy, visible focus/hover/pressed states, truthful paused HUD snapshot, readable 200 percent UI scale, subtitles, motion reduction and persisted settings. Reject default fonts, card grids, large opaque color blocks, deep-blue borders, slash-slash labels, debug text, focus traps or direct boot into gameplay.

Review daylight environment lighting, neutral exposure, contact shadows and event-driven audio/VFX across the complete mission. Require readable real materials, distinct weapon/mechanical/footstep/impact/enemy/objective/bomb/dialogue/ambience/music layers, bounded effects with world scale and surface response, and no clipping. Reject overexposure, bloom flicker, missing geometry during camera motion, darkness/fog/post effects hiding weak assets, silent kills or one sound/effect reused for unrelated events.

Run the complete mission at 1920x1080 after initial load with raw frame-time samples and repeat restart/replay three times. Target 60 FPS and no sustained explosion dip below 45 FPS for three frames. Reject fatal Godot errors, crash, soft lock, input/camera/collision escape, duplicated enemies or events, unbounded particles/audio/corpses/signals, navigation deadlock, texture shimmer, disappearing map surfaces or state drift after restart.
